doc.brief: Used by list widgets to represent items in a [`ListModel`](xref:gtk:Gio.ListModel).
doc.md:
Used by list widgets to represent items in a [`ListModel`](xref:gtk:Gio.ListModel).

`GtkListItem` objects are managed by the list widget (with its factory)
and cannot be created by applications, but they need to be populated
by application code. This is done by calling [`ListItem.set_child()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_child).

`GtkListItem` objects exist in 2 stages:

1. The unbound stage where the listitem is not currently connected to
   an item in the list. In that case, the [`ListItem:item`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#property:item)
   property is set to `NULL`.

2. The bound stage where the listitem references an item from the list.
   The [`ListItem:item`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#property:item) property is not `NULL`.

get_activatable.brief: Checks if a listitem has been set to be activatable via [`ListItem.set_activatable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_activatable).
get_activatable.md:
Checks if a listitem has been set to be activatable via
[`ListItem.set_activatable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_activatable).

get_child.brief: Gets the child previously set via [`ListItem.set_child()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_child) or `NULL` if none was set.
get_child.md:
Gets the child previously set via [`ListItem.set_child()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_child)
or `NULL` if none was set.

get_focusable.brief: Checks if a listitem has been set to be focusable via [`ListItem.set_focusable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_focusable).
get_focusable.md:
Checks if a listitem has been set to be focusable via
[`ListItem.set_focusable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_focusable).

get_item.brief: Gets the model item that associated with `self`.
get_item.md:
Gets the model item that associated with `self`.

If `self` is unbound, this function returns `NULL`.

get_position.brief: Gets the position in the model that `self` currently displays.
get_position.md:
Gets the position in the model that `self` currently displays.

If `self` is unbound, `GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION` is returned.

get_selectable.brief: Checks if a listitem has been set to be selectable via [`ListItem.set_selectable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_selectable).
get_selectable.md:
Checks if a listitem has been set to be selectable via
[`ListItem.set_selectable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:set_selectable).

Do not confuse this function with [`ListItem.get_selected()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem#method:get_selected).

get_selected.brief: Checks if the item is displayed as selected.
get_selected.md:
Checks if the item is displayed as selected.

The selected state is maintained by the list widget and its model
and cannot be set otherwise.

set_accessible_description.brief: Sets the accessible description for the listitem.
set_accessible_description.md:
Sets the accessible description for the listitem.

The accessible description may be used by e.g. screen readers.

set_accessible_label.brief: Sets the accessible label for the listitem.
set_accessible_label.md:
Sets the accessible label for the listitem.

The accessible label may be used by e.g. screen readers.

set_activatable.md:
Sets `self` to be activatable.

If an item is activatable, double-clicking on the item, using
the Return key or calling [`Widget.activate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:activate) will activate
the item. Activating instructs the containing view to handle
activation. `GtkListView` for example will be emitting the
[`ListView::activate`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListView#event:activate) signal.

By default, listitems are activatable.

set_child.brief: Sets the child to be used for this listitem.
set_child.md:
Sets the child to be used for this listitem.

This function is typically called by applications when
setting up a listitem so that the widget can be reused when
binding it multiple times.

set_focusable.md:
Sets `self` to be focusable.

If an item is focusable, it can be focused using the keyboard.
This works similar to [`Widget.set_focusable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:set_focusable).

Note that if items are not focusable, the keyboard cannot be used to activate
them and selecting only works if one of the listitem's children is focusable.

By default, listitems are focusable.

set_selectable.md:
Sets `self` to be selectable.

If an item is selectable, clicking on the item or using the keyboard
will try to select or unselect the item. If this succeeds is up to
the model to determine, as it is managing the selected state.

Note that this means that making an item non-selectable has no
influence on the selected state at all. A non-selectable item
may still be selected.

By default, listitems are selectable. When rebinding them to
a new item, they will also be reset to be selectable by GTK.

accessible-description.brief: The accessible description to set on the listitem.
accessible-description.md: The accessible description to set on the listitem.

accessible-label.brief: The accessible label to set on the listitem.
accessible-label.md: The accessible label to set on the listitem.

activatable.brief: If the item can be activated by the user.
activatable.md: If the item can be activated by the user.

focusable.brief: If the item can be focused with the keyboard.
focusable.md: If the item can be focused with the keyboard.

selectable.brief: If the item can be selected by the user.
selectable.md: If the item can be selected by the user.
